$comment: Every launcher icon this build carries. `npm run icons:app` turns the art into Android and iOS assets and checks the manifest aliases and the Xcode build setting against this list. The backend keeps the same keys in src/modules/devices/appIcons.ts — a key the server names that a build does not carry is ignored by that build. Never remove an entry once a build has shipped it — an Android phone showing that icon would be left with no launcher entry; stop offering it from the backend instead.
